description.en: Batch pseudonymization for medical text, CSV, JSON, and XLSX in DeepSeek Harness. Deterministic identifier rules run first; an optional OpenAI-compatible model pass adds discovery and verification. Exact-span replacement preserves file structure, tokens stay stable per value, and each batch produces an audit report plus a re-identification vault. DICOM images get header-only de-identification based on PS3.15 Annex E, with pixel data left byte-identical.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中批量匿名化病历文本、CSV、JSON 与 XLSX：先跑确定性标识符规则，可选 OpenAI 兼容模型做发现与复核；按精确区间替换以保持文件结构，同一值保持同一假名，并输出审计报告与映射库。DICOM 影像按 PS3.15 附录 E 只处理头部元数据，像素数据逐字节保留。

description.en: Agent 记忆层：向量召回 + FTS5 双路、命中留痕、分层软淘汰、只读体检器具 · Memory layer for agents: vector + FTS5 recall, recall provenance, tiered soft eviction, read-only audit toolkit. Zero dependencies.
Finite owner-authorized offline Linux Docker jobs with durable audit and external revocation.

Zero deps.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化知识图谱和长期记忆，让 AI 跨会话记住关键信息，越用越懂你。

description.en: Dependency-free local reverse proxy for the DeepInfra API: injects service_tier/fail_fast, auto Standard↔Flex fallback with per-session cooldown locks. Also ships as a DSH plugin.

🏦 给 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的每次任务加一条预算线。支持按金额或 Token 限制消耗、自动拦截/手动放行，防止 Agent 过度消费。  🏦 Draws a budget line across every task in DSH (DeepSeek Harness). Cap consumption by CNY or token count, with auto-interception and burn-rate estimates to prevent runaway costs.

DSH 按需代理插件：需要时才拉起 mihomo 内核，用完空闲自动关闭 —— 平时不占端口、不留后台进程。首次运行自动下载内核（约 61MB），内置设置界面可填订阅或一键导入本机 FlClash 配置。内核与 Windows 系统代理是两枚独立开关：内核只绑 127.0.0.1，起停不改变你的网络环境；动系统代理前先备份原值，关的时候逐字段精确还原（连绕过列表都一字不动），别人占着时只报告不抢。自带节点面板：列分组、列节点、切换后回读确认、一键测延迟。检测到全屏游戏只是不启用代理；检测到 FlClash 等其它代理已在运行就静默让路。On-demand proxy for DeepSeek Harness.
Video gate for DeepSeek Harness: local files only by default, Bilibili only after you approve, ASR runs locally.
Windows XP Luna skin for DeepSeek Harness — Bliss desktop, blue taskbar sidebar, glass window and Luna titlebar.
Audio and video understanding for DeepSeek Harness, with configurable models and FFmpeg setup.

description.en: Embedded closed-loop development cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: the agent builds, flashes, debug-verifies and monitors STM32 boards from one panel, while the user watches every step live - progress ladder, streaming logs, RAM/FLASH usage and decoded serial waveforms. Requires a host Python 3.10+ on PATH (the plugin cannot install it); the ARM toolchain is auto-downloaded on first use (~400 MB, Windows x64 only), and you need an STM32 board with a debug probe.
description.zh: 嵌入式闭环开发驾驶舱（DSH 插件）：agent 在面板里闭环开发 STM32——发现、编译、烧录、调试校验、串口监视，开发过程对用户全程可视化（阶梯进度、实时日志、RAM/FLASH 占用、串口波形解码）。需主机自带 PATH 上的 Python 3.10+（插件不能代装）；ARM 工具链首次使用时自动下载（约 400 MB，仅 Windows x64），并需自备 STM32 板与调试探针。
一个预设搞定 iOS、Android 和鸿蒙的原生开发，写各平台原生语言不用来回切配置。
一站式助手套件，把会话管理、快捷操作和插件增强打包在一起，开箱即用。

description.zh: 每天早上自动压缩空闲会话的上下文，错过就下次启动补跑，也能手动一键全压。
